work.text: Speaker catalog: Professor of Computer Science and Technology Evangelist, Durham University.
Professor Sue Black OBE is an award-winning computer scientist, technology leader and social entrepreneur, passionate about using technology to create positive change.

A Professor of Computer Science at Durham University, she is best known for leading the successful campaign to save Bletchley Park and for founding initiatives including BCSWomen, #techmums and TechUPWomen, supporting women and underserved communities into technology careers.
